name: Unwritten Path
source:
"The fall doesn’t start with a scream. It starts with silence."

You were walking. Another campus day. Another weight pressing down on your chest.
But then... something shifted.

The world trembles. A strange melody lingers in the air. The ground disappears beneath you.
You're not transported. You're devoured.

Into the Abyss is a short psychological-fantasy visual novel where reality fractures without warning, and the boundary between mind and myth dissolves. You will fall not just into another world—but into your own subconscious fears, regrets, and fragments of memory.

Through vivid narration, internal monologue, and surreal transitions, you’ll experience the moment everything familiar collapses.

There are no choices to make yet—only to feel, observe, and descend.

"This is not an escape. It’s an unraveling."

[From [url=https://moralcian.itch.io/unwritten-path]Itch.io[/url]]
